sql_templates.name: VCP_Breakouts
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_data AS (
    SELECT symbol, high, volume, change_pct, market_cap_cr
    FROM market.equity_eod
    WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
      AND series = 'EQ'
), 
scores_data AS (
    SELECT ss.symbol, ss.enhanced_fund_score, ss.stage, svp.vcp_score
    FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks svp
    JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON svp.symbol = ss.symbol
    WHERE svp.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
      AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
      AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
)
SELECT ld.symbol, ld.high, ld.volume, sd.enhanced_fund_score, sd.vcp_score
FROM latest_data ld
JOIN scores_data sd ON ld.symbol = sd.symbol
ORDER BY sd.vcp_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Generate summary focusing on breakout candidates with strong fundamentals.', 'Highlight any potential risks derived from the scores.']
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 1556
